scene_summary: A broad asphalt junction in a tropical Thai town, looking along a narrower street between a peach corner building and pastel pink and green shophouses.
environment_description: A tropical Thai neighborhood lies beneath dense layered blue-gray storm clouds, with a luminous silver-white opening above the distant street. Wet-season planting is lush deep green, with clipped hedges, yellow-green ornamental leaves and scattered magenta flowers rather than autumn colors. Weathered peach, pale-pink, mint-green and off-white plaster buildings have barred windows, recessed concrete balconies, dark tiled roofs and corrugated shop awnings. Coarse charcoal asphalt fills the broad foreground junction, bordered by stained concrete gutters, potted plants and a descending side street on the left. Soft cool daylight comes from the upper-left and central sky, leaving covered shopfronts dark; fine black utility cables run diagonally across the upper-right sky.

palette.season_evidence: Healthy dense green tropical planting beneath heavily clouded stormy skies, without snow or autumn leaf discoloration.
palette.grass_words: Sparse muted dark-green weeds along concrete edges, with almost no open lawn.
palette.foliage_words: Lush deep-green clipped hedges and broadleaf plants, with yellow-green ornamental leaves and small magenta flowers.
palette.ground_words: Coarse charcoal-gray asphalt, dusty gray concrete gutters and pale worn sidewalk edges.
palette.sky_words: Heavy blue-gray and slate-gray clouds surrounding a luminous silver-white opening toward the upper center-left.

terrain.surface: Urban roadside ground concealed largely by asphalt and concrete, with dark soil in narrow planted strips.

roads.surface: Unmarked dark-gray coarse asphalt with patch repairs and subtle tire-darkened areas.
